description: This file defines structures and functions related to struct field handling in the 'cbor' package, including field sorting, visibility rules, and reflection-based field access.

classes.name: field
classes.description: Represents metadata for a struct field used in CBOR encoding/decoding.

classes.name: fields
classes.description: A slice of pointers to 'field' structs, representing multiple struct fields.

classes.name: indexFieldSorter
classes.description: Sorter for fields based on their index slices, used for ordering fields.

classes.name: nameLevelAndTagFieldSorter
classes.description: Sorter for fields based on name, nesting level, and tagging, used for ordering fields.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Retrieves visible fields of a struct type following visibility and tagging rules.

methods.name: appendFields
methods.description: Appends exportable fields of a type to a list, handling nested anonymous structs.

methods.name: isFieldExportable
methods.description: Determines if a struct field is exportable based on its visibility and type.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a struct field by index, handling nil pointers to embedded structs.
